profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Reddit Inc. | Full stack developer | MS in software Engineer from Carnegie Mellon University | passionate for SEO | Entrepreneur
profile.geoLocationName: White Plains, New York, United States
profile.summary: I am SW Engineer that has been doing full stack development for the last 10 years, including things such as E-commerce, Fin-tech systems, Prop-tech and RealEstate, and more. I have experience with backend technologies (Java, JS and node, PHP, Python, Go) and frontend technologies as well (AngularJs, VueJS, SASS, etc). I take ownership of every project I am working on and go the extra mile to make sure it meets requirements and exceed performance and expectations. I am also an entrepreneur and an avid researcher for Search engine marketing techniques and SEO optimization.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Senior Sw Engineer for Reddit Inc i18n team.

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
During the Summer of 2020 I worked with The Technology for Effective and Efficient Learning (TEEL) Lab at Carnegie Mellon University. The main objective of my job was to develop some tools that could help in the implementation of different collaboration and learning mechanisms such as pair and mob programming. I developed a system that uses Selenium to automate the creation of virtual environment in Microsoft Codespaces and I developed a Visual Studio Code extension and a
full Flask + Python backend to support the extension and facilitate all the interaction between students in real time. These Codespaces Environments and this VS Code extension will allow TEEL and CMU to implement mob programming exercises and in-class activities.

Some of the tools used were :

* Selenium to create bots that automate tasks and help us deploy virtual machines in Azure codespaces.

* Python + Flask + Sockets + Mongo db  (backend system until here ) + Typescript  + Javascript + Vuejs + SASS (VS code Extension and UI) to create a VS code extension that communicates with the backend system that syncs data from Mob Programming Sessions and Teams.

positions.title: Co-founder /  Software Engineer
positions.description:
I developed the entire E-commerce platform including a shopping cart, API integrations with inventory systems, API integrations with multiple payment platforms and finally all the API integrations with external sales channels such as Mercadolibre and Rappi. I also implemented all the different on-page SEO strategies that have been generated organic traffic since 2013. Finally during my time at Depelos.co I implemented a system that automates the creation of search Ads campaigns using single keyword ad groups techniques for optimal usage of the ads budget available. 

This system was built with technologies such as Javascript, PHP, AngularJS, SQL databases, Memchache, REST APIs and others.

https://www.depelos.co

positions.title: Co-founder / CTO - Software Engineer
positions.description:
I cofounded a software engineering company called Chipichipi Studio SAS. Since 2009 we worked in multiple projects with companies from sectors such as real estate, investment banks, Law Firms and Insurances. With these companies we developed multiple web apps and APIs that were ready to handle a high load of traffic and that were ready to convert in sales and measure our client's KPIs. This tools send and gather data from external APIs and other systems such as different MLS from different places. With my team we also designed and built a multi tenant CMS (equivalent
to Wix) capable of hosting and editing multiple web apps. This CMS allows us to build complex, multi language websites and web apps in a short period of time thanks to its drag and drop capabilities, its visual grid system and its cloning features. During my time at Chipichipi Studio I was able to work in projects on my own and I was able to lead and work in projects with on site teams and with remote teams in Colombia.

projects.title: Araujo y Segovia SA
projects.description:
Web design and development for Araujo y Segovia SA, on of the biggest Real Estate companies in Colombia. While developing this website we created the foundations for the new internet marketing strategy for the company (SEO, Paid ads in Google Adwords,  Social Media, etc ). By December 2013 the website has duplicated it's traffic getting more than 40,000 visits per month,  more than 25,000 visitors (both in Desktop and mobile site) per month and bounce rate below 20%.


Diseño y desarrollo web para Araujo y Segovia SA, una de las mayores empresas de bienes raíces en Colombia. Durante el desarrollo de este sitio web creamos las bases para la nueva estrategia de marketing en Internet para la empresa (SEO, anuncios pagados en Google Adwords, Social Media, etc.) Para diciembre de 2013, el sitio web ha duplicado su tráfico consiguiendo más de 40.000 visitas al mes, más de 25.000 visitantes únicos al mes y una tasa de rebote inferior al 20%.
